items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Why, we used to go around and listen to Tony Jackson.

ctx.x: We used to use red brick. We had to wash the steps on a Saturday morning. In them days, when we was kids, you had to wash the front steps, you know. You always kept them nice and clean. And then after we washed them, we'd grind this brick up fine and throw it all over those steps. Well, some people did it to keep the bumps from sitting on these steps, you know. Dirty them up. But that was our job when we was kids. Every Saturday we had to go out and clean them and wash the back and wash the front steps. And we…

Nickel was a big thing in them days. Yeah. Well, listen, the only thing I can tell you about, when I, I'll use the expression bumming for the meal, stale bread. Why, we used to go around and listen to Tony Jackson.
